text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In front of the school gate, I bumped into Rice Shower and the others just as they were heading out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onii-sama!
choice_data_list: Are the two of you heading out together now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onee-sama!
choice_data_list: Are the two of you heading out together now?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Rice-chan and I are actually going to an all-you-can-eat dessert buffet!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know! Rice-chan's Trainer,
why don't you come along with us too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'm sure that'd be way more fun for Rice-chan, too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...!
I-If you're okay with that, Big Brother—
choice_data_list: Well then, I guess I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...!
I-If you're okay with that, Big Sister—
choice_data_list: Well then, I guess I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful, Rice-chan!
Alright then, let's all head out together~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So many yummy-looking sweets!
There are so many kinds, amazing, amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-All of this is all-you-can-eat...?! Isn't that amazing, Onii-sama!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-All of this is all-you-can-eat...?! Isn't that amazing, Onee-sama!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan! Let's hurry up and get it!
I can't wait any longer~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two cheerfully headed off to get their own share of sweets.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, I picked a whole bunch!
Rice-chan, what about—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower came back with more than double the amount of sweets that Haru Urara had...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing!
Rice-chan, you gathered so~ many!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? D-Did I take too much?
Is it too much food...? Will I gain weight...?
choice_data_list: I'm gonna eat a ton too!
I'm gonna eat a lot too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? D-Did I take too much?
Is it too much food...? Will I gain weight...?
choice_data_list: I'm gonna eat a ton too!
I'm gonna eat a lot too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I like that! Let's eat a ton
and train a ton!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's true. If I'm going to exercise after this...
then it should be fine to eat, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna conquer all these carrot sweets~! Thanks for the food~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you for the food...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh♪
So delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower continued to happily relish all the delicious sweets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought back a massive pile of sweets, determined not to be outdone by Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, this is amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right! In that case, I'm gonna eat even more~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara went and grabbed even more sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You can't even see the table anymore, can you?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just looking at it makes me happy!
Come on, let's dig in~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you for the food...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh♪
So delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...♪
That was so delicious...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mine was delicious too~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And————
I'm... so full... *thud*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While Rice Shower looked thoroughly happy, Haru Urara and I were so stuffed that we couldn't move...
